concepts.name: 19-shared-lens
concepts.prompt:
Use case: logo-brand.
Asset type: new standalone brand icon exploration for kollens, a crypto KOL and wallet tracking intelligence product connecting onchain data with lens optics.
Create ONE bold centered filled geometric icon called SHARED LENS. A compact unified solid faceted prism or hexagonal body contains TWO linked lens-shaped negative-space openings. The two openings suggest connected KOL wallets seen through shared optics. Use deliberate mirrored or exact antipodal symmetry, generous clear openings, and very few clean cuts. The icon should read as one coherent gold mass with two optical windows, not two loose rings.
Style: precise contemporary geometric vector-like logo, broad solid faces, clean crisp edges, flat exact gold #F9C932. Single icon around 60% of a square canvas width with generous plain near-black charcoal #101113 background.
No wordmark or any text, no lettering, no hidden K, no tiny letter counters, no person drawing, no Mastercard rings. No gradient, texture, grain, lighting, glow, shadows, mockups, 3D shading, camera outline, coins, circuitry, extra elements or watermark.
Keep the silhouette and two optical openings recognizable at 24 pixels and suitable for reconstruction as precise native vector geometry.

concepts.name: 20-aperture-crystal
concepts.prompt:
Use case: logo-brand.
Asset type: new standalone brand icon exploration for kollens, a crypto KOL and wallet tracking intelligence product using optical intelligence.
Create ONE original APERTURE CRYSTAL icon. A filled regular hexagonal crystal is divided by THREE precise optical facet cuts gathering around a clear central triangular negative-space aperture. Design three broad solid gold faces with exact threefold rotational symmetry. The few clean cuts should suggest a three-facet shutter and refracting prism in one coherent compact symbol, with generous visible central opening and controlled equal spacing. Flat vector geometry, strong filled silhouette, recognizable at 24 pixels.
Style: crisp polished vector-like logo, flat exact gold #F9C932, sharp deliberate facets, no fine outlines. One centered icon around 60% of a square canvas width with generous plain near-black charcoal #101113 background.
Single icon only: no wordmark, no text, no letters, no hidden K, no arrows, no cube logo, no 3D shading, no optical ray diagrams. No gradients, texture, grain, lighting, glow, shadows, mockups, camera outline, coins, circuitry, extra elements, or watermark.
Make all three facets structurally equal and geometrically precise, with a clean central triangular aperture and few clear cuts, suitable for analytic native SVG reconstruction.
